user_query: trass gmail with terms mgm, shipbob, within last 1 month

intent.goal: search trass gmail for emails containing mgm and shipbob terms

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    g.subject,
    g.sender_name,
    g.sender_email,
    g.recipient_emails,
    g.body_snippet,
    g.message_content
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%mgm%' OR 
    g.body_snippet LIKE '%mgm%' OR 
    g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%' OR
    g.subject LIKE '%shipbob%' OR 
    g.body_snippet LIKE '%shipbob%' OR 
    g.message_content LIKE '%shipbob%'
)
AND u.created_time >= datetime('now', '-1 month')
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;
